acceptanceCriteria.text: Accent is stored on the Couple Space profile with validation (#rrggbb), copied into revision history, and readable by both members only through the existing membership check.
Saving title plus accent uses the same expected-version conflict, command receipt replay and no-success-before-acceptance semantics as the existing Couple Profile update.
Changing the Couple accent never writes or alters m10.personal_preferences, so each account's own theme/appearance stays independent.
Real desktop Chrome and Pixel7/PostgreSQL tests pass, plus full authenticated regression, database suite, lint, typecheck and build.

checkpointPayload.description: Implement M10 D20 / AC-M10-48: Couple Space title and accent colour shared by both members, versioned with history, without writing any member's personal preferences or appearance.
checkpointPayload.implementationNotes: Migration 0070_couple_theme_accent.sql adds m10.couple_profiles.accent plus revision accent, replaces read/read_history/update functions and normalises lower(btrim()) with a '#rrggbb' CHECK. UI adds checkbox 'Dùng màu nhấn chung', colour picker, preview band and revision swatch; save button renamed 'Lưu hồ sơ chung' because it now saves both fields. Verified: python scripts/integration_db.py 34/34 PASS; Playwright desktop+mobile 34/34 PASS; http project 10/10 PASS; vitest database profile service PASS; lint/typecheck/build PASS.
